scope: Read-only concurrency, lock ordering, idempotence, failed states and late payment/capacity review of staged pending-charge guard; independent of implementation.
verdict: GO for draft PR publication only; no blocking regression found in the introduced state/lock changes. Not approval for schema installation, merge, deployment or live charges.

reasoning.assessment: Prepare/claim acquire order -> provider attempts in stable ID order and never request batch after order. Webhook uses event -> batch -> order -> attempts, expiry/confirmation/adverse finish use batch -> order -> attempts, normal finish uses order -> attempts. Existing reservation replay returns before batch; fresh reservation acquires batch before insert. No new cycle found among these supported paths. Attempt insertion FK refers to the order already locked by the caller.

A failure committed before claim is re-read under the order row lock and blocks both the stale HTTP observation and a fresh source. Both order and attempt must remain pending; no evidence is reset to make the row eligible.

The RPC transaction ends before provider I/O. First eligible claim changes state to submitting and creates a bound attempt ID; subsequent claims observe submitting/paid rather than authorizing additional callbacks. Bound 3DS source/device remains required. Failure committed after an already-authorized claim cannot recall provider I/O, but clears/breaks the old attempt and stale finish cannot rearm it. That limitation is accurately documented.

New preparation/claim mutations do not change the capacity predicate or any capacity-relevant payment/status state. Failed unexpired rows retain their slot. After expiry a new reservation can take it; subsequent verified old success is serialized on batch and kept paid/cancelled with payment_after_reservation_release. No new oversell path found; smooth immediate failed-checkout recovery remains unimplemented.

Whole migration is transactional, accepts known baseline/fixed bodies and function contracts, and preserves data. Installation should be a controlled schema cutover with no concurrent uncoordinated DDL; metadata fingerprint checks alone are not a concurrency lock against another administrator changing functions between check and replacement.

command: --test-name-pattern=pending API read|competing bound 3DS|expired failed hold|failed event queued|failure committed after claim
validation.engine: fresh PGlite in memory via SHA-verified immutable SQL fixture; callbacks fabricated in-process

limits: PGlite serializes statements on one backend; Promise.all tests are transaction ordering checks, not independent-session lock waits, concurrent MVCC, or deadlock proof.
Static graph covers the reviewed RPCs/triggers; out-of-contract direct service/owner DML or concurrent DDL is not validated.
No external DB/provider/socket/native PostgreSQL/403 bypass, source edit, publication, deployment or real charge was performed.

Draft description must preserve outstanding real Culqi acceptance, multi-session contention and installation limitations; database/runtime behavior remains unchanged until a separately authorized migration install.
